s: Which one of the following is covered by the Kisan Credit Card Scheme?

s: Before the launch of Kisan Rin Portal (KRP), farmers used to submit manual claims under the Interest Subvention and Prompt Repayment Incentive schemes to which of the following institution/s?
o: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and NA-
Reserve Bank of India and NABARD
National Payments Corporation of India and Reserve
More than one of the above
x: To provide farmers with affordable short-term crop loans, the Government of India runs the Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS) and the Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) scheme, along with an additional interest subvention provision. To ensure transparent and faster settlement of claims, the Kisan Rin Portal (KRP) was launched in 2023. Before the launch of KRP, manual claims under the Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS) and the Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) used to be sent to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and NABARD. It may be noted that, technically, farmers did not directly submit these claims to RBI or NABARD; rather, banks submitted them to RBI and NABARD based on the loans extended to farmers. Therefore, in the given question, the statement “farmers … used to submit manual claims” is not technically accurate.

Agriculture marketing in most states is regulated by the Agricultural Produce Market Committees established by state governments under the respective Agricultural Produce Market Committee Act. The APMCs provide infrastructure for the marketing of agricultural produce, regulate the sale of such produce, collect market fees from such sales, and regulate competition in agricultural marketing. Option (a) is incorrect: The Act empowers the central government to control the production, supply, distribution, storage, and trade of essential commodities. Option (c) is incorrect: The Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937 was the first legislation enacted by the Central Government to formulate standards and carry out grading and marking of agricultural and allied commodities. The apex organization for marketing cooperatives at the national level is :
x: NAFED, set up on 2 October 1958, is the apex cooperative marketing body at national level. FCI is a grain procurement agency, not the apex marketing cooperative.

s: NAFED is mainly connected with :
x: National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India (NAFED) is related to the agricultural marketing. It was established on 2 October 1958. It is an apex organization under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, which deals with marketing cooperatives for agricultural produce in India. NAFED has been started with the objective to organize, promote and develop marketing, processing and storage of agricultural, horticultural and forest produce, distribution of agricultural machinery, implements and other inputs, undertake inter-state import and export trade, wholesale or retail and to facilitate, coordinate and promote the marketing and trading activities of the cooperative institutions, partners and associates in agricultural and other commodities. Thus, while NAFED is also related with agricultural implements, but its main objective is to promote cooperative marketing of agricultural produce to benefit the farmers.
